title: Book One · Chapter 116: The Picture Stays Folded
story:
Steady rain returns during the night.

By morning, the shallow puddle along the yard wall is wider. The walking path is still clear. Dad checks the path first. Then he can leave for Mr Sun's. “Use the dry side,” he tells Ronan. Adults will deal with the roof, not Ronan.

Ronan puts the folded picture in his school folder. He does not put it in the class book. He does not ask Miss Wu for wall space either.

At school, Miss Wu checks the drying table with him and Mei. An adult checked four of the exercise books. They are dry enough to set aside now. Their pages are wavy. The pages will probably stay like that. Two books still have damp corners. Miss Wu needs to change their clean support paper again.

“May I take the four back?” Ronan asks.

“Mr Qiu will collect them,” Miss Wu says. “Or he can ask your mother to bring them.” “They are his stock. We shall not send them out into the rain in your bag.”

They make a new note: four set aside, two still drying. Ronan reads it twice. He wants every word about Mr Qiu to be right today.

Mei sees the folded picture when he opens his folder. “What is that?” she asks.

“I need to ask Mr Qiu about this drawing.”

“Can I see?”

“Not the words yet. They are wrong.”

She nods and goes back to her own bird picture. They worked together before. But Ronan can keep this folded paper private. She leaves the folded paper with him.

After school, Mum takes Ronan to the closed stall. They meet Mr Qiu there. Another shop owner lets them stand under his roof. They stay on a firm dry strip beside the shop. The heavy roof sheet at the stall is still not safe for children to touch. An adult moved the CLOSED TODAY card out of the rain. Now it is low down in a sheltered place.

Ronan tells Mr Qiu about the books. Four are set aside; two are still damp. Then he takes out the drawing. He keeps it folded.

“I did not show it at school,” he says.

“Thank you.”

“My sentence said, ‘Mr Qiu lost his books.’ Most are dry. I wrote about you and did not ask about help first. That was wrong.”

Mr Qiu looks at him for a moment.

“Yes.”

“I am sorry.”

“I hear you.”

Ronan hopes Mr Qiu will smile. But he does not smile at once. A woman passes. “When can I buy pencils?” she asks. “I still need a place to sell,” Mr Qiu says. He speaks to her himself, then turns back.

“May I draw only the stall?” Ronan asks. “Without the private part?”

“I will check the books tomorrow. Then we can talk. I do not want to choose in this rain.”

Ronan nods. He wants an answer now. But Mr Qiu said, “We can talk tomorrow.” He will wait until then to ask again.

At home, the two numbered crates remain in Mrs Lan's front room. She will keep them dry through the next check. She agreed to keep boxes. She did not agree to a shop. Mr Qiu still needs to ask about another counter. If he cannot use it, he will ask Mrs Lan more.

Mum gives Ronan a dry cloth for his folder. He takes the picture into his own room. He lays it flat there. He keeps the three correction notes beside it. Tomorrow he can bring the drawing without the sentence. Ronan will ask Mr Qiu about the drawing first.

Outside, the rain keeps moving along the wall. His wooden boat is dry on its shelf, green beside blue. The stall is still closed. Two books still need time. Tomorrow he can check the books with Miss Wu. Then he needs to speak to Mr Qiu again.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- set aside＝单独放好
- sheltered＝有遮挡的
- lets them＝允许他们
- correction notes＝修改笔记

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：wavy＝起皱、不平；support paper＝衬纸；crate＝木箱。

## 读句提示

**I will check the books tomorrow. Then we can talk.**

我明天会检查书。然后我们再谈。把when I have checked拆成先后动作。

## 理解问题

1. 第116章末，哪些实际问题仍未解决？
2. Ronan怎样道歉，又为什么没有立刻得到所有许可？
